entities.text: High Court Of Judicature At Patna
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
Heard learned counsel for the petitioners, learned counsel for the O.P. No. 2 and learned APP on behalf of the State.
2. The present petitioners apprehends their arrest in connection with Complaint Case No. 2427 of 2023 punishable for the offences under Section 498A of the Indian Penal Code and  of the Dowry Prohibition Act.

3. Issue notice to opposite party no. 2 by both modes (ordinary process as well as speed post with A/D) for which requisites etc. must be filed within two weeks.
4.
Learned counsel for both the parties jointly requests to refer the matter before Patna High Court Mediation Centre to Patna High Court CR.
MISC. No.11418 of 2026(2) dt.23-02-2026 settle the dispute amicably by way of Mediation.

5. Both the parties have to appear on 12.03.2026.
6.
The learned Mediator is directed to submit his report before this Court prior to next date of hearing.

7. List this case on 20.04.2026.
